title: router_led token change is dead code — sprites bake the old green; palette, sprite generator, and palcheck pin now disagree
evidence:
app/render/view.odin:836-840:
draw_router :: proc(v: ^View, id: u32, c: rl.Vector2, port_capacity: i32) {
	if v.sprites.ok {
		sprite_blit(&v.sprites, sprite_index_puck(port_capacity), c, sprite_puck_target(v, port_capacity))
		return
	}

tools/gen_sprites.py:39 (unchanged by this diff):
ROUTER_BODY, ROUTER_DARK, ROUTER_LED = "#5E6E80", "#3E4A5C", "#2E8B57"

diff, app/render/palette.odin:
-	p.router_led = jcol(obj, "router_led", {46, 139, 87, 255})
+	p.router_led = jcol(obj, "router_led", {0, 205, 90, 255})

harness/palcheck.odin:154,274:
LED_GREEN := rl.Color{46, 139, 87, 255}
	check(count_exact(calm, LED_GREEN) > 10, "puck LEDs", count_exact(calm, LED_GREEN))

Measured pixels: goldens/juice/30000ms.png contains 0 px of {0,205,90,255} and 50 px of {46,139,87,255}; assets/sprites/puck_1/2/3.png contain 91/238/666 px of #2E8B57 and 0 px of #00CD5A.
detail: With sprites loaded (app/main.odin:282, harness/goldens.odin:76 — every real path) draw_router blits and returns; the new token never renders. The evidence doc's "node accents up (router LED token)" does not ship.
recommended_fix: Regenerate sprites via gen_sprites.py with ROUTER_LED="#00CD5A", update palcheck's LED_GREEN pin, re-bless; or revert the token to {46,139,87} until sprite regen is in scope.

title: Stale CVD mode tables override the vivid pipe tiers — the network-pop change is absent for colorblind-mode players
evidence:
data/palette.json base tokens:
  "pipe_copper":   [240, 110, 0, 255],
  "pipe_steel":    [0, 150, 240, 255],
  "pipe_fiber":    [255, 215, 0, 255],

data/palette.json modes.deutan (protan identical, tritan near-identical) — unchanged by this diff:
      "pipe_copper":     [188, 108, 40, 255],
      "pipe_steel":      [122, 132, 146, 255],
      "pipe_fiber":      [36, 60, 132, 255],

app/render/palette.odin, palette_apply_mode:
	for tok in Palette_Token {
		i := int(tok)
		if t.set[i] {
			palette_set_token(dst, tok, t.colors[i])
		}
	}

Measured: goldens/a11y_deutan/30000ms.png contains 690/1266/1225 px of {188,108,40}/{122,132,146}/{36,60,132} and 0 px of the new vivid family. Repo-oracle simulation of the NEW base pipes: min pairwise sim-dist deutan 100.9 / protan 122.0 / tritan 147.9 (threshold 48); new base lanes under tritan fail at 28.7.
detail: palette_apply_mode overrides pipes/lanes in every CVD mode, reverting to the pre-pop muted family the user ruled "boring". The pipe-tier overrides are unnecessary: the new base passes the separation oracle unaided in all three modes.
recommended_fix: Re-derive the CVD anchors for the vivid canon: drop pipe-tier overrides (base passes all modes), keep/re-anchor tritan lane entries (new base fails 28.7<48); verify with tools/derive_a11y_palettes.py + palcheck.
